name: Amitabh
reason: Correct: amita + ābhā, of boundless light; also an epithet of light/Buddha but widely used Hindu boy name.

name: Ashwath
reason: Sacred peepal (aśvattha), revered tree of the Gita; established name, esp. in South India.

name: Bhupesh
reason: Correct: bhūpa + īśa, lord of kings; king.

name: Chandresh
reason: Correct: candra + īśa, lord of the moon / Shiva who bears the moon.

name: Harendra
reason: "Lord of Hara" is a misreading; hara + indra means Hara (Shiva) as the chief lord.

fix.name: Harendra
fix.meaning_en: Lord Shiva (Hara) as the supreme lord.

name: Hitendra
reason: hita means welfare/benefit; "lord of well-wishers" is weak and loose.

fix.name: Hitendra
fix.meaning_en: Lord of welfare; one who wishes good for all.

name: Kailashnath
reason: Correct: lord of Kailasa, Shiva; कैलास is the classical Sanskrit spelling (Hindi often कैलाश), acceptable.

name: Kashyap
reason: Spelling Kashyap matches कश्यप (the sage), not काश्यप (Kāśyapa, his descendant); meaning adjusted accordingly.

fix.name: Kashyap
fix.meaning_en: The Vedic sage Kashyapa, one of the Saptarishis and father of gods and beings.

name: Mukesh
reason: Etymology disputed: mukti + īśa does not regularly give mukeśa, and "lord of Muka" is misleading (Mūka was a demon slain by Shiva). State uncertainty honestly.

fix.name: Mukesh
fix.meaning_en: Popularly "lord of liberation" (mukti + īśa), but this derivation is irregular; etymology uncertain.

name: Nandkishore
reason: Correct: young son of Nanda, Krishna.

name: Pitambar
reason: Correct: clad in yellow garments, Krishna/Vishnu.

name: Rakesh
reason: Correct: rākā + īśa, lord of the full-moon night, the moon.

name: Ravishankar
reason: Acceptable: ravi + śaṅkara, sun and Shiva / beneficent sun.

name: Somesh
reason: Correct: lord of the moon, Shiva (cf. Someshvara).

name: Sukesh
reason: Correct: having beautiful hair; common name (a rakshasa Sukesha exists but was a Shiva devotee, not a notable villain).

name: Yadavendra
reason: Correct: lord of the Yadavas, Krishna.
